Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff
Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff

Pride and Progress News-highlights: 1. Gay Week in Review, with Andy Humm, David Strah, Joyce Hunter, and Christopher Lynn, sponsored by the Human Rights Campaign Fund 2. Discussion of the lawsuit against Governor Cuomo's "anti-sex guidelines" 3. Discussion of gay activism against anti-gay politicians and finding allies in politics COMMERCIAL: GCN Fundraiser 4. Balancing sex education and AIDS education for children and young adults COMMERCIAL: Human Rights Campaign Fund 5. Andy Humm on politicians advocating abstinence to counter AIDS 6. News Watch, CDC adds dementia and emaciation to AIDS symptoms 7. Holland, upscale condom boutique opens on outskirts of Amsterdam's red light district 8. Smoking found to possibly cause impotence 9. A Florida man goes on a shooting rampage because he believed that some people thought he was gay COMMERCIAL: "First Hand" gay magazine 10. Sports Report COMMERCIAL: GCN Fundraiser 11. Lavender Health, Ron Vauchon with Ellen Zaltzberg discussing various conferences centered around gay health issues 12. Closing credits
The Right Stuff: 1. Show Bits with George Trahanis, interview with Bob Bowyer of the off-Broadway show, "Funny Feet" COMMERCIAL: The Monster 2. Olivia Negron interviews Karen Abbott and Bob Werner, two activists who placed pro-gay stickers around "Heritage USA," the park owned by Tammy Faye and Jim Bakker COMMERCIAL: "First Hand" gay magazine 3. Interview with Joe di Sabito about condom companies avoiding advertising in gay media COMMERCIAL: GCN Fundraiser 4. Media Watch with Brandon Judell, interview with Mark Thompson, author and cultural editor of "The Advocate" magazine
